flags.subject: Valve's own calibration caveat
flags.detail: Valve's README: the expected-vs-observed slope is shallower than 1; the model 'tends to underestimate win rates at the low end and overestimate at the high end'. Treat extreme percentages with caution.

flags.subject: Our line = Valve curve re-calibrated on official VRS data (k = 0.4568)
flags.detail: Fitted on 6765 matches (2025-12-01..2026-10-05), each rated with the PREVIOUS monthly VRS snapshot. Held-out test 2026-08-03..2026-10-05 (n=1709): log loss 0.66185 (Valve raw, k=0.972821) -> 0.64351 (calibrated); Brier 0.22936 -> 0.22575.
